reviews.text:
DO NOT GO HERE if you value your pets life!!!
They made me wait at least four hours while my pet sat in pain, and when they finally saw me, told me she had a bladder stone and they'd send me the prescription to fix it through Chewy. Cut to a week later, still no prescription, my pet gets worse, and when I finally march down there and make them do their job, they tell me they won't provide what I need. This is commonly known as malpractice, and will cost your baby's life. Go literally anywhere else.

Art City Urgent Care is great! I’ve had such positive experiences here, from the front desk, to the techs, to the vets. I’ve had to come a couple times for my cat, Juno. Dr. Tran is the best, she takes time to clearly explain the injury and treatment plan, and I feel like it’s clear how much she cares and how invested she is in the cat’s recovery. I had a lot of questions throughout her latest injury (she ripped out her claw) and Dr. Tran, as well as the techs when I called, were awesome in helping me feel comfortable with how her recovery was progressing. I’m sure I ask more questions than most, but they’ve never made me feel like I’m a bother! Also, my boyfriend was there picking up medication for our cat last week, and someone was saying goodbye to their pet while he was there. The front desk had a fake candle lit and a sign and he said a lot of the staff were comforting the pet’s parents, which makes me feel like Art City really cares about their patients. We are so lucky to have it here in our neighborhood! We’ve actually just switched our wellness services over there for Juno and my other cat as well due to our positive experiences.

They were able to get my dog in for appointments pretty easily, which was nice. The first time they gave me an estimate of about 20 min but it ended up being over an hour because they were delayed so that could’ve been better. The worst thing was when I brought my dog in for a dry eye check up and we saw a new vet (Georgia Christensen) - after seeing him for a few minutes, she decided to talk to me about putting him down because of his mobility issues. I said that wasn’t something I was interested in discussing that day and was only there about his eyes, but she pushed it because she said otherwise she would feel she’s not doing her job. I was already having a really bad day for other reasons, and she didn’t seem to care that she was making me cry and I was asking her to stop. Every other vet I had taken my dog to was so kind to both of us, so although this place is closest to our home, I didn’t feel comfortable ever going back. The only good thing is that she’s no longer on the website so probably not practicing there anymore.

I recently had to take my very sick 15 year old cat Luna to Art City Vets Urgent Care. I give them my sincere and heartfelt thanks for their compassion and professionalism. Unfortunately my beloved Luna did not make it home with me. However, they helped us through one of the most difficult days of my life and provided the best care possible to her. I am so grateful for their compassionate care. I highly recommend their services and staff.
They are the best. Very trustworthy. They have taken such good care of my Jasper! 🖤 …

Dr. Tran is extremely knowledgeable and has amazing bedside manner. She walked us through every step of our dog’s surgery with digestible explanations. It is apparent that she cares for her patients (and their humans).

I think that they are great.  Professional and very friendly.  They care about every pet that walks through the door. My dog had to have an extensive ear treatment and they went above and beyond and helped me get funding for the procedure so I could afford to have my pet taken care of. If more vets were around like Art City Vet, maybe we wouldn't have the number of abandoned dogs in Philadelphia that we have. Facts.

I can not say enough good things about Art City. All of the staff- from Avery answering my questions on the phone to Elina using her own cat to demonstrate how to give my cat pills- are phenomenal and truly care. I highly recommend Art Cuty and will not take my animals anywhere else.
Great staff great service amazing people skills and well maintained clean building  All staff were great to me and my dog The whole business

Overall a wonderful experience during a stressful situation. Everyone from the desk to the techs to the vet were friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable. For an emergency visit, the prices were affordable as well. Highly recommend.

Have taken my dog here on two occassions where she needed immediate care and couldn't recommend their service more. Staff is friendly and attentive, and I appreciate them reviewing all potential solutions with you while outlining which are immediately necessary to assist with time and cost of visit. I've consistently found their staff friendly and knowledgable, and our visits never feel transactional or like a money-grab situation.

The staff and vets at Art City are superb. They are caring, efficient, and professional. The hours are very convenient. I very much appreciate the detailed assessments and plans given by the veterinarians. Fantastic care!
Good communication and excellent care.  They did not ask for every expensive test, but planned phase I minimal diagnostics needed with a phase II if needed.

I love ACV so much! Everyone is so kind, calm and caring! Every staff member is amazing at their job.   appreciate how grounded and nice everyone (front desk people, techs and vets) is and how thorough the doctors are.

I just moved and had to bring my dog in to the Urgent Care; all staff made me feel super comfortable to establish care going forward and helped navigate payment options. Front desk and vets were extremely kind & informative! I would definitely recommend this practice :)

From Gordo 🐾
Thank you to everyone at Art City Vet for taking such wonderful care of me. Your kindness, compassion, and genuine love for animals made me feel safe. The staff and doctors are amazing, and your accurate diagnosis and dedication mean the world to me and my family. Thank you for giving me the best care possible. Love Gordon❤️🐾

Great visit.  The only issue I had is it took 2 hours for us to be seen, otherwise I would have given a 10 The doctor was very detailed in her discharge instructions and she took the time to answer all of my questions.

They took very good care of my buddy Terror while he was getting checked and vaccinated! They gave him a bandana and flea and tick preventative before leaving! I'd gladly go back there anytime!     How caring and attentive they were to my pup!
Everyone at the front desk was so helpful and friendly! Dr. Tran was pleasant to work with and very informative. She addressed all my concerns clearly and thoroughly. Thanks!

The staff at Art City Vets are wonderful. They are kind, welcoming, patient, and helpful. I have taken my cat to the urgent care twice now and each time they have been patient with all of my (many) questions. I especially appreciate that they always follow up by phone a day or so after discharge to check in on how my pet is doing. I can tell they truly care.  Dr. Wilson was great, super patient with me and very helpful and knowledgeable. I feel horrible for not getting the name of the staff person who helped me but when I went in on Sunday morning they (I always default to "they" when I don't know) were sitting on the right and offered to help me as I was on crutches. They were very friendly and helpful and I really appreciated that they were trying to make it so I didn't have to get up and walk a lot.  Patience, kindness, empathy, knowledge

Amazing care for me and my dog! Everyone was amazing. When I walked in they already knew it was me with Duchess, and made me feel as if they would take great care of her, which they did!!  Everyone made me feel at ease because I was freaked out. Duchess is doing great and we received a checkin phone call which was also very nice.

I called ahead of time for Urgent Care & told them how long it would take me to get there. I was told to come right in, no mention of how long the wait was, so I assumed the wait wouldn’t be that bad if there was one at all. I gave them my information and headed in. The wait was 2 hours. I also noticed people in the waiting room waiting for a long time to get their invoices to checkout after their pets had been seen, which made me more eager to leave. That and by standard they do not allow owners in the exam rooms. I was told they would accommodate me when I asked about their policy, but I did not feel comfortable with the way they responded.
Incredible experience; attentive and compassionate during a stressful visit. Took amazing care of my pup. Would recommend to anyone.

Very grateful for your team. You made a stressful situation as simple as possible, helped me make informed decisions, and plan for future vet appointments. Everyone was great but extra shout out to Dr. Tran.

Second update: the medical director of the office emailed me to excuse themselves of any liability. Every vet I’ve had and person who has gone to a vets office knows I’ve never declined bloodwork. No one suggested it or that there were risks associated with the shot Norman was given. Despicable. Told me they will no longer engage with me because I said I was reporting them.

Update: Emma from client services called me on the day Norman was put down. While I appreciated it, I am devastated. I told her the doctor who treated him didn’t have the basic understanding of renal disease or they were careless. She stayed on the phone with me and said the medical director would call me back. I replied saying the medication is processed through the kidneys and the manufacturer states blood tests should happen before administering to a cat with renal issues. She hung up on me. DO NOT GO HERE.

Before anyone else from the office wants to step in or write a smug reply, do some quick research into convenia and cats with renal disease. I wish I had, but I trusted the vet. Guess that’s my fault too.

Original review:  I will preface this with saying my cat is very old at 19, but that’s also part of the problem. Unable to find a slot at my regular vet, I took my CKD cat Norman to Art City when he couldn’t eat due to dental problems that caused painful teeth grinding. He’s had this problem before and I called my former vet to ask what we had used to treat it a few years ago when he wasn’t a good surgery candidate.

I waited hours and hours in the waiting room only to find out I wasn’t allowed to come back with him. The doctor, Dr. Vivian Tran called on the phone from the back. I told her we had resolved his jaw issue  before with a convenia antibiotic shot. She helped me weigh the pros and cons of oral vs injectable antibiotics for ease of care and continued food advocacy, but never mentioned the dangers of giving a senior cat with chronic kidney disease this shot. Something easily found on the drug websites that apparently applies to all long acting drugs.  He seemed dizzy upon arrival at home and when I called back and asked for the doctor, she told the nurse “I’m going home for the day, have her take him to the ER.”

DO NOT GO HERE. They are either uninformed or just don’t care.

Within a day Norman was paralyzed and his kidney levels sky rocketed. He will be euthanized tomorrow.
Thanks so much for the 5-stars, Kim!

i'm always gratified when i arrive at art city vets - from the front desk staff to the vets to the techs who attend to george and gracie we felt known, remembered, cared for and about. the whole front desk/reception staff.  i feel calm and relaxed upon walking through the door to acv. i know we're all in good hands.

Thorough wellness visit, answered all of our questions, made excellent recommendations. Everything runs very smoothly. The whole team was great! Took all the time necessary to check our dog out thoroughly and answer our questions.
My cat and I were treated with care and consideration. I highly recommend this urgent care facility. the handling and care of my cat.

We are so happy with the care and compassion that everyone at the practice displays. It’s beyond a vet practice, more like a family. We know our dogs are treated with kindness and love but the entire staff ( especially Dr. P.). Cannot say enough about the medical care. Best Veterinarians in the city!!
Thanks so much for the review, Jonathan!

This place is amazing, from reception to follow up. I felt that my pet's needs were met with care and excellent professionalism! The entire visit put my mind at ease and relieved my stress and my dog's! I highly recommend Art City Vets & Urgent care! Vet Laura and the Tech working with her, tech, can't remember her name, but I remember she's in school and had such a Zen energy that my Chow Chow responded well to! Highly recommend and can't praise them enough! The reception and check out was smooth and the staff was kind & courteous. Everything!!!!

ACV has really impressed me with their bedside manner. Our dog Falkor passed away at ACV in Nov '24 and their team was so lovely and respectful. That will always be an impactful moment for me. Like Falkor, my dog Nano has been going there since we moved to the area in 2020. And I rescued another dog Helga, who is also a patient with ACV now. She's actually had to have urgent and sudden surgery in the last week and everyone at ACV has been so kind, patient, and informative. I don't feel "extra" asking all the questions I have or providing detailed information as a worried pet mom. Thanks to the ACV team for being A+ wonderful human beings first and foremost. Extra thanks to Dr. Carmellini who has been so on top of Helga's care.

Very quick and easy appointment, especially considering the last-minute nature (we were traveling inside of 48 hours and realized we needed one of our pups' vaccinations was expired. Filled out travel form on Tuesday afternoon, was given a time slot to come in on Wednesday and was in and out in under 30 min). Vet tech and vet were both very nice and very thorough. Got us in quickly and made it stress free!

It was a great experience I thought there was a more serious issue with Rileys breathing but turns out it was just an ear infection they were so helpful and understanding with everything this is our vet from now on Laura Zemanian is really really awesome The compassion and understanding she has is great and I was able to speak with her directly which made me feel alot better the vet techs were really helpful too
This place is THE place to take your pet. These doctors are reasonably priced, they have a heart, and they will always work with your pet! I cannot say more positive things about this place.

We've been going to Art City for years. The staff take the time to get to know our pets and their health and are always willing to answer questions.

We've always been given transparent information with options, and never coerced into getting an exam or procedure done. That type of informed consent is the distinction between this practice and others where it just feels like the vets are trying to upcharge. And especially in recent years, their prices have been really competitive. The cost of an urgent care visit is especially reasonable--not a whole lot more than a regular visit.

Doctors Zemanian, Glantz, and Carmellini have all been wonderful recently--helping us understand and navigate various health concerns between our dogs and cat. And I can't say enough nice things about the front desk staff and techs. We really appreciate how warm, caring, patient, and gentle with our pets they always are. This makes the experience much less scary for them.
Thank you for the 5-star review!

The team is absolutely wonderful! We’ve had several urgent care visits and a few wellness visits for our dog and each time we’ve had different doctors and they’ve all been great to deal with and are extremely helpful. One time we did have to be referred elsewhere and they gave a list of several places nearby that could help with the issue because it required surgery but in the meantime, they gave us extensive information on what they did know. The urgent care on the weekend is usually a little busier but during the week, we’ve been seen pretty quickly. Overall, I’ve loved their service and will continue using them as long as I’m in Philly!!

My cat's relatively urgent issue was handled with great efficiency and care. I was able to get two different next-day appointments, despite these being her first vet visits in Philly. The time spent in waiting rooms was incredibly short all things considered. Medical services provided were also done in a timely and attentive manner; my cat did not love having to get blood drawn several times, but she was definitely not too badly off after being worked on by the Dr.s here. Clean and calm spaces; reasonable pricing. Scheduling was easy with every receptionist I spoke with. Both Vets who worked on my cat spoke with me directly and clearly about the implications and prognosis of their tests, which I appreciated. I would highly recommend this practice for being able to provide services on short notice without any extreme wait times or fees.
Everyone is so knowledgeable and compassionate and caring and very supportive..plus very helpful.. Dr Laura Zemanian The whole Team ‼️‼️Ethel Loves You All ‼️‼️😺

I love this vet hospital. I love the care that they gave my pet. They showed lots of love and tender care. I highly recommend this hospital. I wanna Thank Dr Katelyn Jones , DVM for giving my Pet Chloe the best care and advice. Thank you so much for all your services. They were knowledgeable about my pets care and came up with a health plan.
The absolute best vets and staff in the city plus coffee/tea/soda snacks while you wait?!? Yes, please!
Thank you for the 5-star review!

Attentive and kind staff met me where I was at and made the visit less overwhelming. Everyone did amazing- Kind reception and understanding staff. There were a few guests and a fire drill yet everyone helped to make me and my pet feel safe and relaxed.

We have never been here before, but had a potential emergency with a foster cat in our care. From my initial phone call through the end of our visit, everyone was really amazing. They were very helpful, efficient, kind and knowledgable. Thankfully our cat did not end up needing emergency treatment, but from this experience, would reccommend!

Horrendous experiences here of late. My cat almost died during her dental, and they tried to sell me on another dental once she recovered because it's all about $$ to them ... Another time: in a real bind before traveling out of town, I brought the cat for what I thought would be a simple visit with a prescription - instead, I was upsold on a bunch of unnecessary tests because that there how they operate AND I still had to bring the cat to a different provider for adequate treatment. It's also luck of the draw - Dr. Glantz is exceptional, while Dr. Shaffer is atrocious and you never know who you will get even when you request. Do not recommend.

I am so glad to have discovered you and that you were able to help my cat who has struggling more than I realized. Lovely space and staff! Art City Vets took concerns seriously and were able to see my cat quickly and give her treatment.

Saying goodbye to our family dog was one of the hardest things we've ever had to do, but she was very old and very sick, so it was time. The kindness and compassion from the staff at this office was absolutely incredible! Every person that we interacted with treated us with such care and understanding. They even waived the clinic fee, which was incredibly thoughtful and deeply appreciated. I am beyond grateful for the compassion that they showed my family and our beloved dog in her final moments. Thank you for helping us through such a difficult day!

Urgent Care staff and doctor were all extremely caring and helpful, from the phone call I made to ask about bringing my sick cat in to the diagnosis and recommendations for treatment. Amanda Carmellini, the on-call vet when I took my elderly cat in for urgent care, was extremely supportive during a stressful time and made my cat comfortable as quickly as possible. The front desk staff were all very friendly.

Art City made me feel so reassured as my cat was undergoing surgery for a dental procedure (COHAT). I really appreciated the follow-ups post-op, the clear and thorough instructions for medication and after care, and when there was an incident during the procedure (my cat’s fault, not the surgery teams), they covered the costs to fix the issue and made the transfer to another facility smooth and easy on both my cat and I.

Dr. Zachary Galantz was amazing. He was very caring, thorough and answered all questions. He also was able to get us into a hospital with oncology within an hour. Ginger has a very aggressive form of lymphoma and because of his kindness and ability to secure an appointment so quickly, we are hopeful that we will have more time with her. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts! The amazing doctor! I found it on my invoice, Dr. Zachary Glantz Thoroughness of staff
the best doctors who found the cause and gave my princess a chance to live! Thank you so much!🙏🙏🙏
Thank you for the 5-star review!
Thank you for the 5-star review!

I appreciate and am grateful that an emergency urgent care is part of your practice. All the staff I interacted with are very kind. I appreciate that everyone listened to my concerns on my dog's condition, and that they treated her with such care. The nurses and Dr. Schafer kept us up to date on every step while our dog was receiving treatment. It was reassuring to know what was going on and to be kept informed.
Best staff ever! Always go above and beyond which is why I always bring my cats here. I know I can trust that they are getting the best care possible. Everyone The staff truly cares.

Art City vets were amazing and thorough give that was shih zhu Dice ate grapes.  They made sure we had all the help.necessary to get through this with a great outcome.  Dice is fine and still thriving.  I am grateful to the entire staff.

Unbelievably, this is the first review I have ever written, and I was prompted to do so because I have, over a period of five years, found Art City Vet to be consistently outstanding. The fact that they offer two general branches of service, urgent care and wellness, is what initially drew me to them when I first moved to the Philadelphia area, but what has made me stay with them is their general overall excellence. Dr. Glantz resolved issues that others could not resolve in years in a single visit; his scope and depth of knowledge is nothing short of incredible. I am a veterinarian myself, but not for my own pets, and I trust Art City completely with all of them.

I was thrilled when they recently added new integrative medicine services with Dr. Xie, and I have found it just as outstanding as every other service they offer! We have aging dogs with complex constellations of issues. Dr. Xie took the time to understand everything about them, from their personalities and behavior to their complex medical issues. She is kind, patient, gentle, diligent, compassionate, and incredibly intelligent. Her attention to detail and follow through truly is second to none. It is abundantly clear that she has complete command of her field. While our dogs are geriatric with medical conditions that need to be managed rather than resolved, I have seen a distinct difference in their quality of life after we started seeing Dr. Xie for acupuncture and herbal supplements. The days that follow our appointments with her are their best ones: they eat better, have more energy, and just overall seem brighter and more like themselves.

It is clear that Art City has put an incredible amount of energy and thought into all of their services, and this new addition really is the icing on the cake! I will always be grateful that our pets are their patients.
Failed to diagnose my cat with feline herpesvirus type-1 (FHV-1). Told me the issues she was having with her eye was nothing to be concerned about....
Everyone is really kind, communicative and helpful at this practice

This place is amazing I took my kittens to two other vets and was left shrugging my shoulders with no plan or suggestions.  The vet here had a plan and didn’t look to tack on unnecessary tests she even helped to discount my bill since I had already spent so much other places.  If I could give 10 stars I would.  It’s clean inside ALL the staff were friendly and compassionate! I won’t be taking my babies anywhere else.  Thank you for helping my kittens get better!!!!❤️‍🩹

I brought my cat in for an emergency Urinary issue. I called ahead gave them some info and they cat the past medical records from my usual vet and when I got there they took him right back to get looked at. Dr Whiter took time with me going over findings and explaining everything in normal terms so there was no confusion with what was going on with my cat. Overall 10/10 the front desk staff was amazing and kind so was the tech that looked at my cat as well as the Dr herself. We spent about an hour and 15 minutes there total which is great timing for an urgent care visit mid day on a Saturday.

The emergency team listened to our concerns about our cat Gracie (who is a patient there) and addressed our needs thoroughly and quickly! I really don't know how to put into words our gratitude for the situation we were in. Everyone at Art City, from the emergency team and the non emergency team (across the street), is absolutely lovely and wonderful! Grace, my husband and I say THANK YOU!

I cannot say enough about this place.i thought I would have to put my baby down.nope.not the case.the staff,the place itself,everything. Was absolutely AMAZING.i didn't even know about them.was recommended.i saved thier number 1000000 recommend!! Fantastic place!! Fantastic people!! They saved my baby!!! I'm not sure of the names but everyone every single person in there was FANTASTIC ESP the woman who liked my shirt.😉AMAZING personable lovely sweet ALL the things!!(give her a raise! She knows who she is!!)I was there 3-30.at the location in downtown Philly. EVERYTHING
Friendly, efficient, and knowledgeable, all in a clean, well-designed, and welcoming environment.

My ER visit at Art City Vets with my dog Sawyer went great. The staff was very knowledgeable and explained everything in simple, easy-to-understand terms. Sawyer was diagnosed with a UTI and intermittent paraphimosis. They clearly explained the condition, the urgency, and how to monitor it at home.

He was prescribed Carprofen 25 mg and Amoxicillin 100 mg for the UTI. For the paraphimosis, they advised minimizing arousal and keeping a close eye on him, with instructions on what to do if it worsens.

Overall, I felt confident in their care and appreciated how thorough and informative they were. What I appreciated most is how knowledgeable and patient the staff was. They took the time to explain everything in simple terms, made sure I understood Sawyer's condition, and gave clear instructions on how to care for him at home. I also appreciated how seriously they treated the situation and how attentive they were throughout the visit.
Everyone on the ACV team is always nice and accommodating. Communication is always very clear and you know the staff loves animals!

I moved here in 2023 used Art City Vets from day 1

Dr.Shafer?!PHENOMINAL
All other staff?!PHENOMINAL

dont change, keep doing what you do  and how you do it

ENTIRE STAFF=  Compassion, knowledge, empathy, efficiency all around "from soup to nuts"😂🤷🏽‍♀️👍🏽✌🏽💜

If there was a zero stars I would select it, my wife showed up with our dog and young child  for our dogs scheduled vet appointment and she was told that her appointment had been canceled. She was unaware of this and This was not told to her ahead of time that they canceled the appointment. Their Reason was of their new “policy” that if you do not confirm the appointment they will cancel the appointment (and do so without telling you)
Thank you for the 5-stars!
The care from all team members was exceptional Listening to my concerns was appreciated.
Great atmosphere and workers! communication in what was needed before, during and after my cat's procedure was great and delivered in a way that i was able to understand and keep up with
Everyone was super courteous, I was seen quickly and I got all my questions answered.
They always take care of my babies like they’re their own! Truly couldn’t ask for better care.

The front desk staff are always kind and understanding. Dr. Tran has been so helpful over the last 6 months or so that I've been bringing my cat Shrimpy in. She is willing to reply to my emails and I really appreciate that she takes the time to do that, as I have an easier time articulating my concerns in writing. It's convenient to be able to bring my cat in without an appointment if the situation warrants it.
Excellent service and care. Dr. Jenna Wilson, thank you for taking such great care of Ody!

Best practice I've ever been to. Caring staff, informed and informative medical teams, and beautiful facility. So thankful to have such a great care team during stressful times. Dr. Tran is one of a kind - I am so appreciative of her kindness , her expertise, and her professionalism!

Great facility! Professional, kind, caring, knowledgeable and very organized! They are well-staffed and keep things moving at a relaxed but good pace. Very comfortable waiting room with indoor and outdoor seating, snacks and coffee. All of the front desk staff and the vet techs are wonderful and of course Dr. Vivian Tran, a superstar! She is so smart, professional, compassionate and patient. a real diagnostician!

You guys were so helpful and caring in treating Lil Boy. I'll be bringing all my babies to you for care. Thank you. You have an amazing team. Everyone I encountered made me feel like I'd made a great choice bringing Lil Boy there. Outstanding communication. I was informed every step of the way about Lil Boy's care and the front desk staff were friendly, informative and efficient.

My dog was in a scuffle with another dog and received a bite on his neck. I didn’t think it was too bad at first so I went home and noticed later he had blood on his neck and a puncture wound. I brought him first thing in the morning to Art City.
The staff were very helpful and friendly. I do have insurance but there’s a deductible and limit reimbursement. I was not expecting a nearly $400 bill.
A friend of mine had a similar situation recently and it was $118. At a vet close by Art Museum Veterinary. The office visit was $90 more and the meds similar was $29 for 10 pills as opposed to $156 for 20.   Like I said I am covered by insurance and the owner of the other dog offered to pay. I accepted half because they were always friendly before the incident. I expect to pay for care but it seems pretty mercenary to charge that much for meds when PetMeds would have been $57 for 20 pills.

Really liked the way that the tech, Kevin, and Dr. Zamanian spoke with me, and the way that they took time to answer my questions. The place does not smell dominantly either of animal excretions or of disinfectant, which seems like it's pretty remarkable. The vibe of the staff was positive and energetic. I like my usual vet, but the vibe there is excessively low-key and doldrum-y at times. Given I was worried about my pet, it helped to have a clean, welcoming, positive space and folks. There was some confusion (?) with front desk and getting finished with paperwork, which resulted in what seemed like a very long wait to leave, but this is, in the end, minor. Still waiting for labs, but overall it was positive.

The staff and doctors were so attentive and considerate. Excellent Service: on-time check in; explanation of the procedure; Dr call to explain the results; smooth check out; happy doggie; next day f/up call . Kudos to all from front desk to the whole surgery team.

Art City Vets is the best and they handle my dog Zelda with so much care. She has vet anxiety and they’re always very patient with her. The doctors take time to walk you through any concerns, check if you understand, and have great follow up. The staff is always very kind and welcoming.

Art City Vets exceed our expectations the urgent care was quick very professional from the time we came in friendly and knowledgeable.  The care and time they took answering all our questions and concerns was appreciated.

It’s clear when a team genuinely loves what they do, and ACV's staff demonstrates that.  I travel over 45 minutes and deal with Philly street parking just to come here, and it’s always worth it.

The CSR team is friendly and efficient, the techs are skilled and attentive, and every vet we’ve worked with has been knowledgeable and compassionate.  We usually don't even request a specific veterinarian when we schedule our appointments, because we know we'll be in the very best hands no matter who we see.
Service and care is great, I wish it was more affordable. The overall attitude of the staff is great. Always helped me in a pinch !

Quality care, can tell they really care about the patients, very good about follow up. Thank you to Dr. Tran and all the nurses that took care of and checked in on Matzo Ball before during and after his surgery! Thank you to the nurses at the front desk at the urgent care check in who made sure to let us know we could call anytime to check in on him. We completely trust Art City with our beloved cat.

Very nice, and accommodating for my dog who does not get along well with other dogs. Jenna Wilson And Shamera were very sweet.
The overall visit was pleasant

The staff at ACV have been treating our "Pups" for a few years now and they never have a fear of coming in for their care because everyone is so good to them and they are totally comfortable. That was not the case with our prior vet's office. Thank you for all that you do take care of our "Boys"! Oh my goodness. The one gal at the receptionist desk at the Wellness office with dark hair and great tattoos. My apologies for not remembering her name. She is always so good when speaking with us humans and to our pups. She makes us all feel right at home. How much the staff truly cares about the well being of our pups. It really shows!

Art City Vets is by far the best vet center I've been to in Philadelphia.  Dr. Aller is extremely knowledgeable, skillful, and accommodating. During an earlier emergency visit, a staff member told me Chloe had “three days, or a few days at most” to live and immediately handed me euthanasia papers. This statement was presented as definitive, without explanation of how that timeline was determined or any acknowledgment of the emotional impact. Chloe ultimately lived for several weeks after that visit, which made the way this information was delivered feel especially careless.

When I later brought Chloe in for euthanasia, the process was not explained properly beforehand. I was told it would be painless and quick, but no one explained what could happen if complications arose. When the first injection was administered, Chloe screamed. I was holding her and was completely unprepared for this, especially after being told the process would not cause pain.

After that, staff struggled to find a vein and repeatedly poked Chloe, causing visible distress and fear. Multiple staff members were brought into the room, and the process became long and chaotic, with no explanation of what was happening or why. Chloe was just laying there being poked with needles.

At one point, I was asked if I wanted to come back another day to euthanize her because they were unable to find her veins. Being asked to make that decision in the moment while grieving felt inappropriate and overwhelming.

I had clearly stated beforehand that I wanted to be holding Chloe when the final injection was given. Despite this, a staff member entered the room and silently administered the final medication into Chloe’s kidney while she was on the table. I was not holding her and did not get the goodbye I had asked for. When I asked if it was over, I was simply told, “Yup.”

This was the worst experience I could have imagined during an already devastating loss. The lack of empathy, communication, and respect for my wishes caused unnecessary trauma. I hope this clinic seriously reevaluates how it handles end-of-life care.
